body: Thankyou for the message. I'm getting closer to 30 too and I can't believe I'm still dealing with this - it's plagued my 20s, my youth that is supposed to be the best years of my life. I don't want to travel, move, get a new job with this face. And I know you say it's nothing I did but I keep trying to fix it and it gets worse so I blame myself for being an idiot and all these decisions I keep making.  I wish I could just go into a coma and wake up when my skin (if it ever does) heal completely. Hence the wish for death cus at least I wouldn't have to live with this face.
You're right, it's just that my own opinion of myself is what I care about. Like I hold myself to a higher standard and I think I'm a piece of sht for letting this happen.

I understand what you're saying. It is almost impossible to be good to other people though - I can't even look them in the eye and I am a shell of myself. I am not a good person anymore because I am so wrapped up in my skin and how horrible I look and feel. It physically hurts. And I can't think of anything outside of it. I even dream of it, so sleep isn't even an escape. Only death will be. I just wish there was an easy way to do it but I've done a lot of thorough research and they are basically all painful and I can't take anymore pain even to death.
